name: gitea
description: Work with any Gitea instance from Claude Code: repositories, files, branches, issues, project boards, pull requests, reviews, organisations, time tracking, Gitea Actions, releases, packages, wiki and webhooks via a bundled MCP server.

gitea_url.title: Gitea server URL
gitea_url.description: Base URL of your Gitea instance, e.g. https://gitea.example.com

gitea_token.title: Gitea API token
gitea_token.description: Personal access token (Gitea → Settings → Applications). Stored in the system credential store, never in settings.json.

allow_write.title: Allow write operations
allow_write.description: Create and edit repositories, files, branches, issues, pull requests and releases.

allow_destructive.title: Allow destructive operations
allow_destructive.description: Delete repositories, branches, tags, files, releases, labels and comments. Each deletion still needs your confirmation.

allow_admin.title: Allow administrative operations
allow_admin.description: Manage organisations, teams, collaborators, branch/tag protection and webhooks. Each change still needs your confirmation.

ca_file.title: CA certificate file (optional)
ca_file.description: Absolute path to a PEM file with your private CA, for self-hosted instances with internal certificates. Leave empty otherwise.

use_system_ca.title: Trust the operating system CA store
use_system_ca.description: Also trust certificates from the OS trust store (useful for corporate CAs).

profiles_file.title: Profiles file (optional)
profiles_file.description: Absolute path to a JSON file defining additional Gitea profiles (see docs/CONFIGURATION.md). Leave empty for a single server.

allow_insecure_http.title: Allow insecure HTTP
allow_insecure_http.description: Permit http:// URLs (sends the token unencrypted). Only for local test instances.
